note: Read 2026-10-13 from nosler.com only (robots.txt empty = no restrictions). Line pages: Partition, AccuBond, AccuBond LR, Ballistic Tip Hunting/Varmint/Lead Free, Ballistic Silvertip, Expansion Tip, Custom Competition, RDF, Varmageddon, Solid, Solid Base; all 33 Partition, 5 Solid and 3 Solid Base component product pages (Bullet Base/Bullet Profile spec fields); most factory pages (Loaded with ... sentence, Bullet Type/Profile). Also checked the 2026 product guide PDF (no extra base data). Empty on purpose: Ballistic Tip Varmint construction (core not named); Solid construction (only "lead-free alloy", metal not named); Partition PPT tip (Protected Point, no enum); Bonded Solid Base tip/base (protected point, base shape not stated); factory Partition/Solid base (cartridge pages give no base). Partition tip = per-product Bullet Profile (Spitzer -> spitzer_soft_point). Factory line facts come from the Nosler line pages (same maker). Fetch error once: 458 Cal 300gr Ballistic Tip Hunting product page (line page covers it).
